description.zh_cn: 点击一个可见目标；有 indexed evidence 时优先给 element_index。
description.en_us: Tap a visible target; when indexed evidence is available, prefer element_index.

prompt_guide.zh_cn: - click(target_description, element_index?, x, y): 点击可见目标；优先填写 indexed evidence 的 element_index，x/y 只是兜底。
prompt_guide.en_us: - click(target_description, element_index?, x, y): Tap a visible target; prefer indexed evidence element_index, x/y are fallback only.

description.zh_cn: 要点击的目标描述。
description.en_us: Description of the target to tap.

description.zh_cn: 优先填写。OOB indexed page evidence 中目标元素的 #index；提供后系统会用 live XML 中该元素中心覆盖坐标。
description.en_us: Prefer this. The #index of the target element in OOB indexed page evidence; when provided, the runtime uses that live XML element center over raw coordinates.

description.zh_cn: 可选。live XML 中已确认的无障碍节点 id。
description.en_us: Optional. Confirmed accessibility node id from live XML.

description.zh_cn: 可选。录制或 XML grounding 得到的 Android resource-id，用于重放定位诊断和迁移。
description.en_us: Optional. Android resource-id captured from recording or XML grounding, used for replay targeting diagnostics and transfer.

description.zh_cn: 兜底点击位置的屏幕绝对像素 X 坐标。
description.en_us: Fallback absolute screen-pixel X coordinate of the tap target.

description.zh_cn: 兜底点击位置的屏幕绝对像素 Y 坐标。
description.en_us: Fallback absolute screen-pixel Y coordinate of the tap target.

description.zh_cn: 长按一个目标。
description.en_us: Long-press a target.

prompt_guide.zh_cn: - long_press(target_description, element_index?, x, y): 长按目标；优先填写 element_index，x/y 只是兜底。
prompt_guide.en_us: - long_press(target_description, element_index?, x, y): Long-press a target; prefer element_index, x/y are fallback only.

description.zh_cn: 要长按的目标描述。
description.en_us: Description of the target to long-press.

description.zh_cn: 优先填写。OOB indexed page evidence 中目标元素的 #index；提供后系统会用 live XML 中该元素中心覆盖坐标。
description.en_us: Prefer this. The #index of the target element in OOB indexed page evidence; when provided, the runtime uses that live XML element center over raw coordinates.

description.zh_cn: 可选。live XML 中已确认的无障碍节点 id。
description.en_us: Optional. Confirmed accessibility node id from live XML.

description.zh_cn: 可选。录制或 XML grounding 得到的 Android resource-id，用于重放定位诊断和迁移。
description.en_us: Optional. Android resource-id captured from recording or XML grounding, used for replay targeting diagnostics and transfer.

description.zh_cn: 长按位置的屏幕绝对像素 X 坐标。
description.en_us: Absolute screen-pixel X coordinate of the long press.

description.zh_cn: 长按位置的屏幕绝对像素 Y 坐标。
description.en_us: Absolute screen-pixel Y coordinate of the long press.

description.zh_cn: 长按时长，单位毫秒。
description.en_us: Long-press duration in milliseconds.

description.zh_cn: 向一个可见输入目标输入文本；有 indexed evidence 时优先给 element_index。
description.en_us: Type text into a visible input target; when indexed evidence is available, prefer element_index.

prompt_guide.zh_cn: - input_text(target_description, text, element_index?, x, y): 向输入框输入；优先填写 element_index，系统会先走 XML 节点输入，x/y 只是兜底。
prompt_guide.en_us: - input_text(target_description, text, element_index?, x, y): Type into an input field; prefer element_index so the runtime can use XML node input first, x/y are fallback only.

description.zh_cn: 要输入文本的目标输入框描述。
description.en_us: Description of the input target.

description.zh_cn: 要输入的文本内容。
description.en_us: Text content to type.

description.zh_cn: 优先填写。OOB indexed page evidence 中目标输入框的 #index；提供后系统会用 live XML 中该元素中心覆盖坐标。
description.en_us: Prefer this. The #index of the target input field in OOB indexed page evidence; when provided, the runtime uses that live XML element center over raw coordinates.

description.zh_cn: 可选。live XML 中已确认的无障碍节点 id。
description.en_us: Optional. Confirmed accessibility node id from live XML.

description.zh_cn: 可选。录制或 XML grounding 得到的 Android resource-id，用于重放定位诊断和迁移。
description.en_us: Optional. Android resource-id captured from recording or XML grounding, used for replay targeting diagnostics and transfer.

description.zh_cn: 兜底目标输入框中心的屏幕绝对像素 X 坐标。
description.en_us: Fallback absolute screen-pixel X coordinate of the input target center.

description.zh_cn: 兜底目标输入框中心的屏幕绝对像素 Y 坐标。
description.en_us: Fallback absolute screen-pixel Y coordinate of the input target center.

description.zh_cn: 从起点滑动到终点。
description.en_us: Swipe from the start point to the end point.

prompt_guide.zh_cn: - scroll(target_description, x1, y1, x2, y2, duration_ms?): 在屏幕上滑动。
prompt_guide.en_us: - scroll(target_description, x1, y1, x2, y2, duration_ms?): Swipe on the screen.

description.zh_cn: 本次滚动想浏览或定位的目标描述。
description.en_us: Description of what this scroll action is trying to browse or locate.

description.zh_cn: 可选。OOB indexed page evidence 中 Scrollable regions 的 Sindex；提供后系统会在该区域内生成安全滑动坐标。
description.en_us: Optional. The Sindex of the target Scrollable region in OOB indexed page evidence; when provided, the runtime generates safe swipe coordinates inside that region.

description.zh_cn: 配合 scrollable_index 使用的浏览方向。
description.en_us: Browsing direction used with scrollable_index.

description.zh_cn: 起点屏幕绝对像素 X 坐标。
description.en_us: Start absolute screen-pixel X coordinate.

description.zh_cn: 起点屏幕绝对像素 Y 坐标。
description.en_us: Start absolute screen-pixel Y coordinate.

description.zh_cn: 终点屏幕绝对像素 X 坐标。
description.en_us: End absolute screen-pixel X coordinate.

description.zh_cn: 终点屏幕绝对像素 Y 坐标。
description.en_us: End absolute screen-pixel Y coordinate.

description.zh_cn: 滑动时长，单位毫秒。
description.en_us: Swipe duration in milliseconds.

description.zh_cn: 打开指定应用。
description.en_us: Open a specific app.

description.zh_cn: 目标应用的 Android package name。
description.en_us: Android package name of the target app.

description.zh_cn: 回到桌面。
description.en_us: Go to the home screen.

prompt_guide.en_us: - press_home(): Go to the home screen.

description.zh_cn: 返回上一级。
description.en_us: Go back one level.

description.zh_cn: 不执行 UI 操作，只重新获取当前页面状态、包名和 Accessibility tree。
description.en_us: Do not perform a UI action; refresh the current page state, package name, and Accessibility tree.

prompt_guide.zh_cn: - 内部状态刷新：运行时每轮自动读取当前页面状态；该动作不暴露给模型或前端，不点击、不滑动、不输入。
prompt_guide.en_us: - Internal state refresh: the runtime reads the current page state automatically each turn; this action is not exposed to the model or frontend and does not tap, swipe, or type.

description.zh_cn: 为什么需要重新获取状态，例如上一步操作失败、页面无变化或当前页面不确定。
description.en_us: Why state refresh is needed, such as previous action failed, page did not change, or current page is uncertain.

description.zh_cn: 执行本轮 OmniFlow recall 明确给出的 OOB 复用指令。调用后根据结果继续选择下一步。只能使用 recall context 里出现过的 function_id，并根据用户任务填写 arguments。
description.en_us: Run one OOB reusable Function explicitly listed in the current-turn OmniFlow recall context. After the result, continue deciding the next step. Only use a function_id shown in recall context and fill arguments from the user task.

prompt_guide.zh_cn: - oob_function_run(function_id, arguments): 当本轮 OmniFlow recall 给出了高度匹配的复用指令时调用；不要发明 function_id，参数必须从用户任务中填写到 arguments；无参 Function 也必须输出 arguments: {}；调用后看结果，未完成目标时继续下一步。
prompt_guide.en_us: - oob_function_run(function_id, arguments): Use only when the current-turn OmniFlow recall context lists a matching reusable Function; do not invent function_id, fill arguments from the user task; no-argument Functions must still output arguments: {}; inspect the result and continue when the goal is not done.

description.zh_cn: 本轮 OmniFlow recall context 中给出的 Function id。
description.en_us: Function id shown in the current-turn OmniFlow recall context.

description.zh_cn: Function 业务参数；无参 Function 使用空对象。
description.en_us: Business arguments for the Function; use an empty object for no-argument Functions.

description.zh_cn: 仅当当前页面或上一轮工具结果直接证明用户目标已经完成时结束。
description.en_us: End only when the current page or previous tool result directly proves the user's goal is complete.

prompt_guide.zh_cn: - finished(content?): 仅在当前页面或上一轮工具结果直接证明目标完成时调用；不确定就继续执行下一步。
prompt_guide.en_us: - finished(content?): Call only when the current page or previous tool result directly proves completion; if uncertain, continue with the next action.

description.zh_cn: 给用户的最终完成说明，可为空。
description.en_us: Final completion note for the user. May be empty.

description.zh_cn: 向用户询问或请求手动协助。
description.en_us: Ask the user a question or request manual help.

prompt_guide.zh_cn: - info(value): 询问用户或请求用户协助。
prompt_guide.en_us: - info(value): Ask the user for information or manual assistance.

description.zh_cn: 你要问用户的问题或需要用户执行的说明。
description.en_us: Question to ask the user or instructions for the user to perform.

description.zh_cn: 反馈当前上下文与目标不匹配。
description.en_us: Report that the current context does not match the goal.

prompt_guide.zh_cn: - feedback(value): 请求上层重新规划。
prompt_guide.en_us: - feedback(value): Ask the upper layer to re-plan.

description.zh_cn: 反馈原因。
description.en_us: Reason for the feedback.

description.zh_cn: 任务无法继续时终止。
description.en_us: Abort when the task cannot continue.

prompt_guide.zh_cn: - abort(value?): 在任务无法继续时终止。
prompt_guide.en_us: - abort(value?): Abort when the task cannot continue.

description.zh_cn: 终止任务的原因。
description.en_us: Reason for aborting the task.

description.zh_cn: 让用户在若干选项中选择一个。
description.en_us: Ask the user to choose one option from a list.

prompt_guide.zh_cn: - require_user_choice(options, prompt): 让用户做互斥选择。
prompt_guide.en_us: - require_user_choice(options, prompt): Ask the user to make a mutually exclusive choice.

description.zh_cn: 可供用户选择的选项列表。
description.en_us: List of options the user can choose from.

description.zh_cn: 要求用户做选择的提示文案。
description.en_us: Prompt shown to the user when asking for a choice.

description.zh_cn: 让用户确认当前状态后继续。
description.en_us: Ask the user to confirm the current state before continuing.

prompt_guide.zh_cn: - require_user_confirmation(prompt): 让用户确认后继续。
prompt_guide.en_us: - require_user_confirmation(prompt): Ask the user to confirm before continuing.

description.zh_cn: 要求用户确认的提示文案。
description.en_us: Prompt asking the user for confirmation.
